releases.legal_basis: Section 251 (ECC 1-03(d)/2012) is in place for the flow of identifiable data to and from the HSCIC. Approval for ONS Mortality data has been granted by the Office for National Statistics under the Statistics and Registration Service Act 2007 section 42(4) for the purposes of assisting the Secretary of State for Health or the Welsh Ministers in the performance of his or their functions in relation to the Health Service.
Section 251 (ECC 1-03(d)/2012) is in place for the flow of identifiable data to and from the HSCIC.

texts.63a2590b31cb: Use of this data is for the purpose of the National Bowel Cancer Audit analysis for the 2014 Annual Report and for the in-depth analysis of the National Bowel Cancer Audit to focus on rectal cancer pathway, detailed exploration of why patients dont get surgery and five year outcomes. the three in-depth analyses will be published in seperate reports.
